title: Privileged Account Activity Requiring Context
closure: Not ready: ownership, authorisation, change-ticket context, endpoint activity, and account compromise indicators are unresolved.

evidence.observation: A privileged account authenticated from a source not previously associated with the account in the synthetic baseline.
A maintenance window overlaps the authentication timestamp, but the responsible engineer and source device are not yet verified.
No post-authentication process evidence is included in the case pack.

hypotheses: Authorised maintenance by a privileged administrator
Shared or proxy source obscuring the true endpoint
lessons_learned: Unusual privileged authentication should trigger context collection, not automatic insider attribution.
Change-ticket and endpoint evidence should be correlated before closure.
